b: Nick Soulsby, author of a new book charting TNB's bizarre 45-year journey, selects ten points of entry into the maze-like discography of a group dedicated to absurdity and the refusal of fixed meaning
TNB at Cafe Oto in 2017, by Baby RL

At the tail-end of the 70s, artists in the non-academic realm joined illustrious composers of electroacoustic and experimental music in probing where the outer limits of music might lie, and the extent to which its core characteristics could be twisted to unleash new sounds. Magnetic tape and fanzine culture alike inspired a wider web of individuals with no industry-backing, no money, no audience, and no media connections to create, then to share their work with anyone who cared enough to...
